required contractual document Download ExcelDownload PDF **38** Checkpoints **10** Sections Once per section or phase; updated if significant changes required Contractor, QC Engineer [SP 20:2002](https://infralens.in/code/IS-20-2002) [IS 73:1992](https://infralens.in/code/IS-73-2013) Related [📐SP 20](https://infralens.in/code/SP-20) [✏️Max Aggregate Size By Member](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/max-aggregate-size-by-member) [📘Aggregate Grading (IS 383)](https://infralens.in/handbook/aggregate-grading) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧rcc-design](https://infralens.in/tools/rcc-design) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 1. SCOPE & OBJECTIVES | | 1.1 | Scope: Define paving work scope (length, width, layer type, thickness, area)
Acceptance: Specify: km/m extent, width (lanes), layer designation (DBM/BC), thickness (mm), design standards | Cl. 503 — Work definition | | | 1.2 | Objectives: State quality, safety, environmental, and schedule objectives
Acceptance: Density target (≥98%), zero safety incidents, weather compliance, schedule adherence | Cl. 503 — Goal setting | | | 2. MATERIALS & SPECIFICATION | | 2.1 | Bitumen: Grade, source, supplier, quality cert, storage temperature, handling procedure
Acceptance: Grade (60/70, 80/100); source approval; test certs; storage 135-150°C; no overheating | Cl. 501 — Binder specification | | | 2.2 | Aggregates: Source, grading, LA abrasion, impact value, fines content, supplier
Acceptance: Source approval; grading limits; LA ≤40%; impact ≤30%; fines ≤10%; e&f ≤25% | Cl. 501 — Aggregate specification | | | 2.3 | Mix Design: JMF (Job Mix Formula) binder content, grading, target density, Marshall spec
Acceptance: JMF approved; binder % by weight; Marshall stability ≥1800 kg, flow 2-4mm, VIM 3-5% | Cl. 503 — Design parameters | | | 2.4 | Quality Standards: Compliance with IS 73, IS 2386, SP 20 specifications
Acceptance: All material and construction conform to applicable IS codes and specifications | Cl. 503 — Standard compliance | | | 3. PLANT & EQUIPMENT | | 3.1 | Batch Plant: Type, capacity, make, model, age, maintenance schedule, certification
Acceptance: Minimum 40 tph capacity; scales certified ±2%; hot bins temperature control; cleanliness | Cl. 503 — Equipment specification | | | 3.2 | Paver: Type (fixed/tracked), make, model, width, screed control (manual/automatic)
Acceptance: Self-propelled paver; width match road width; automatic screed preferred; <5 yrs old | Cl. 503 — Paving equipment | | | 3.3 | Roller: Type (static/vibratory), weight (≥3t), no. of rollers, operating procedure
Acceptance: Vibratory roller ≥3t static weight; 2-3 rollers for redundancy; maintenance log | Cl. 503 — Compaction equipment | | | 3.4 | Support Equipment: Sweeper, chip spreader, water truck, temperature measurement devices
Acceptance: Mechanical sweeper for cleaning; calibrated thermometers (IR gun, thermocouple) | Cl. 503 — Ancillary equipment | | Showing 10 of 38 checkpoints ·View all → 1. PLANT & EQUIPMENT 3.1Batch Plant: Type, capacity, make, model, age, maintenance schedule, certification Cl. 503 — Equipment specification (SP 20) ✓ Minimum 40 tph capacity; scales certified ±2%; hot bins temperature control; cleanliness 3.2Paver: Type (fixed/tracked), make, model, width, screed control (manual/automatic) Cl. 503 — Paving equipment (SP 20) ✓ Self-propelled paver; width match road width; automatic screed preferred; <5 yrs old 3.3Roller: Type (static/vibratory), weight (≥3t), no. of rollers, operating procedure Cl. 503 — Compaction equipment (SP 20) ✓ Vibratory roller ≥3t static weight; 2-3 rollers for redundancy; maintenance log 3.4Support Equipment: Sweeper, chip spreader, water truck, temperature measurement devices Cl. 503 — Ancillary equipment (SP 20) ✓ Mechanical sweeper for cleaning; calibrated thermometers (IR gun, thermocouple) Showing 10 of 38 ·View all → Inspection Sign-Off APPROVED APPROVED WITH MODIFICATIONS REJECTED — RESUBMIT Prepared By Name / Sign / Date Reviewed By Name / Sign / Date ### More related 📐IS / IRC codes -
